verdict.rationale: The Washington Employment Security Department is a state agency that administers unemployment insurance, employer taxes and paid leave. Its online surface is an authenticated filing portal (EAMS/eServices), not a platform for user-built automations. Versioning, reviewing and rolling back automations is therefore a wrong-axis question for this kind of product. Amending a quarterly report is a correction to a filing, not version control of an automation, and nothing in the evidence shows the agency offers any automation feature.
